title: Super Bowl LV
overview: Super Bowl LV, played on February 7, 2021, at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, Florida, saw the Tampa Bay Buccaneers defeat the defending champion Kansas City Chiefs 31-9, earning the franchise’s second Super Bowl title and making history as the first team to win the Super Bowl in their home stadium. The Buccaneers’ victory was defined by a dominant defensive performance, a balanced offensive attack, and the continued brilliance of quarterback Tom Brady, who secured his seventh Super Bowl title, more than any single NFL franchise.
